overview: A practical beginner roadmap for learning Python from basic syntax to small projects. It focuses on confidence, repetition, and building useful scripts.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.goal: Understand Python syntax, variables, conditions, and loops.

nodes.title: Set up and write first scripts
nodes.description: Install Python, run simple scripts, and understand how code is executed. Practice printing values and reading beginner examples.

resources.title: Python for Beginners - Programming with Mosh

nodes.title: Variables and data types
nodes.description: Learn strings, numbers, booleans, lists, and dictionaries. Use small examples to see how values change while a program runs.

nodes.title: Conditions and loops
nodes.description: Use if statements and loops to make programs respond to different situations. Practice with short exercises until the flow feels natural.

project.title: Simple quiz game
project.brief: Build a command-line quiz that asks questions, checks answers, and shows a final score. Keep the questions in a list or dictionary.

resources.title: Python for Beginners - Programming with Mosh

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.goal: Use functions, files, and modules to organize useful programs.

nodes.title: Functions
nodes.description: Break repeated logic into functions with inputs and return values. This helps you write cleaner programs that are easier to test.

nodes.title: Files and errors
nodes.description: Read and write text files, then handle common errors safely. Practice saving simple notes or scores to a local file.

resources.title: Reading and Writing Files - Python Docs

nodes.title: Modules and packages
nodes.description: Learn how Python code can be split into modules and reused. Try importing standard library tools before installing third-party packages.

project.title: Personal expense tracker
project.brief: Create a command-line expense tracker that lets you add expenses, save them to a file, and show totals by category.

resources.title: Reading and Writing Files - Python Docs

phases.title: Build Confidence
phases.goal: Practice with project structure, debugging, and small real-world tools.

nodes.title: Debugging basics
nodes.description: Learn to read error messages and isolate problems with print statements or a debugger. Debugging is a normal part of programming.

nodes.title: Work with APIs
nodes.description: Use Python to request data from the web and inspect JSON responses. Start with public APIs that do not need authentication.

nodes.title: Practice small projects
nodes.description: Build several small tools instead of one large app. Repetition helps you remember syntax and develop problem-solving habits.

project.title: Weather summary script
project.brief: Build a script that fetches public weather data, parses JSON, and prints a short readable summary for a city.
